limitations: The Prefill baseline is one fixed-frequency process with five measured generations per prompt, not a cross-process tail-latency distribution.
The controlling console output was captured by the development session but no separate raw log file was retained; the exact aggregate fields are recorded here.
Absolute results apply to the pinned checkpoint, binary, clocks, batch-one policy, non-thinking chat template, C32 schedule, and max1 workload only.
The user-provided vLLM/FlashInfer throughput is not directly comparable until hardware, model, precision, prompt length, concurrency, output length, template, and token accounting are matched.
No OpenAI-compatible API, larger tile, general double/triple buffer, continuous batching, MTP, or FlashInfer integration is claimed by this record.
